preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in board) and all(len(row) == len(board[0]) for row in board)
preconditions.description: The board is a non-empty rectangular 2D list of strings (letters), with all rows having the same length.
The word is a non-empty string of lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(all(board[r + dr][c + dc] == word[i] for i, (dr, dc) in enumerate(path)) for r in range(len(board)) for c in range(len(board[0])) for path in dfs_paths(r, c, word))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if there exists a path in the board starting from any cell, moving only to adjacent horizontal or vertical cells without reusing any cell, that spells the word exactly.
